Name: Sunshine Portraits
Author: Zwiebelritter42
Description:
[b]ATTENTION FROM 28.08.2018
[/b]Some users experienced broken Images.

We used Portraiture v1.5.5 (from 24.05.18) for testing our Mod
This seems to work for us even with the newest Stardew Valley Beta and SMAPI.
We don't think that this is a problem with our images. We just added them there is no coding from our side involved.
We tried to run it with the newest Portraiture version. But it seems like Portraiture got a new dependencie that is not up to date. So we couldn't even start the game. We will keep an eye for updates of or dependencies, maybe the newer versions require a diffrent formating of the portraits. 
 



Sunshine portraits replaces the standard stardew valley portraits with lovely  new hd ones. Therefore we tried to keep them close to the standard portraits but giving them the special little details that we thought they might lag.

You can also find us on [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/sunshine-portraits-%E2%99%A5.145040/]Chucklefish forum[/url]

[b]» What it does[/b]
Replace your stardew valley portraits with new lovely designed hd portraits. 

[b]» What it needs[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]-> A great mod for letting you use high res images as portraits in stardew without getting downscaled and pixelish
[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ -> It is needed for the High-Res Portraits mod.

[b]» What we will do[/b]
This modification is still in development and we will keep adding more characters in the future. Our goal is it to replace all ingame portraits not just that bachelors :3
